article.title: Defendant need not be interested in all the relief claimed.
article.content: It shall not be necessary that every defendant shall be interested as to all the relief claimed in any suit against him.
article.html:
5Defendant need not be interested in all the relief claimed.

Order 1, Rule 5

It shall not be necessary that every defendant shall be interested as to all the relief claimed in any suit against him.
